system.description:
Once per Doom Quarter, roll your Smarts Pool. Each Smarts symbol removes one Status Effect from you or an ally; each symbol beyond the number of Status Effects removed heals 1 wound on you or an ally.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.47
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, roll your Smarts Pool. Each Smarts symbol removes one Status Effect from you or an ally; each symbol beyond the number of Status Effects removed heals 1 wound on you or an ally.

automation.onSuccess: Spend Smarts symbols: 1 per Status Effect removed, then 1 per wound healed.

automation.note: Each Smarts symbol (Talent stars count) removes 1 Status Effect from you or an ally; each symbol left over heals 1 wound on you or an ally.
